Alex (fin): Noticed a weird line on today's cloud invoice: apac spot multiplier jumped for GPU-SKU-XL overnight. Usage attribution looks fine but cost jumped ~13k on 6.2k GPU-hours. Need plan for who eats this. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/2026-03-26/line-482
BillingBot: ALERT: vendor_rate_anomaly detected region=apac, sku=GPU-SKU-XL, extra_cost=13000, export=s3://billing/exports/2026-03-26/apac-rate-anomaly.csv
Rina (platform): Vendor support confirmed a mis-applied promo multiplier — they're issuing a credit but ETA 7-10 business days. Suggest temporary smoothing (amortize extra across impacted teams) or Platform reserves cover up to $5k.
Diego (ml): We consumed ~4.1k of the 6.2k GPU-hrs (see internal report). ML-sim can absorb some, but product demo team used ~1.0k for scheduled runs; they'd get hit.
Sam (fin): Proposal: 1) finance creates a temporary amortized charge by team proportional to GPU-hrs and labels it "provisional vendor anomaly"; 2) when vendor credit posts, reverse the provisional charges and apply the credit. Need approvals from Platform for reserve cover and from teams for provisional charge.
Leah (ops): I approve Platform covering up to $5k to minimize team disruption. Leah (ops) :white_check_mark:. Ops will also flag any customer-facing runs so product knows about potential refund flow.
Alex (fin): OK — Sam, prepare provisional charge spreadsheet (team, gpu_hours, provisional_amount, contact_email) and post here. Deadline EOD today so we can notify team leads. We'll reverse once credit arrives. Include audit note: "Vendor rate anomaly apac GPU-SKU-XL — provisional amortization pending vendor credit."
Rina (platform): I'll open vendor ticket and request expedited review. Ticket: VND-2026-APAC-77.
BillingBot: EXPORT ready: s3://billing/exports/2026-03-26/apac-rate-anomaly-breakdown.csv
Diego (ml): Uploading ML breakout now: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-26/ml-spend-breakout.csv. Will coordinate with product on demo team impact.
Sam (fin): Spreadsheet posted: s3://finance/adj/2026-03-26/provisional-amortization-apac.csv. Sending heads-up emails to team leads. Will create INT invoice records for the provisional entries so accounting shows the temporary charge.
Alex (fin): Thanks. Marking action items: Sam prepare provisional charges (done), Rina follow vendor (in progress), Leah confirm reserve cover (done), teams review charge (pending). Closing thread after vendor credit applied and reversals posted. :wave:
